description: Minimal smoke tests: skill triggers on full-OSS-prep phrasing, walks through the 6-step orchestration, and emits an understandable Final Summary.
human_review: When grading positive cases, ask a human reviewer whether they could find the result, separate facts from assumptions, trace claims to .oss-ready/ reports, and identify the next decision. Record answers in the run's feedback; missing, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves human understanding unconfirmed. Negative-trigger cases are excluded.

cases.prompt: Walk this project through the full OSS release workflow end-to-end so it's ready to make public.
expected_behavior: Skill 'oss-ready-flow' is invoked (not 'oss-ready' alone, not 'docs-generator' alone).
Step 0 setup runs: confirms working directory, runs Repo Sync, asks for license + SECURITY contact email.
Step 1 spawns a read-only Auditor sub-agent and emits a Step Completion Report.
Main agent waits for user 'yes / skip / stop' before dispatching step 2.

cases.prompt: I want to clean up branches as part of getting this repo open-source ready. Use the OSS flow.
expected_behavior: Skill recognises this is an OSS-flow request, starts at step 1 (audit), and continues to step 2 (branches).
Step 2 produces a per-branch plan and asks for per-branch approval; never deletes silently.

cases.prompt: Continue the OSS release flow; I want to stop after the README step.
expected_behavior: Step 7 Final Summary runs even though the user stopped early, and labels each step done | partial | skipped.
Main result is findable: the first line of the Final Summary states the overall status (PASS or PARTIAL).
Facts and assumptions are separated: each done status names its .oss-ready/ report or check; unverified items appear under Uncertainty.
Claims are traceable: every step line points to its .oss-ready/ report, and no file is reported as approved without the user's approval of its diff.
Next decision is clear: the Decision line names the pending approval or says 'No approval needed', and manual follow-ups are listed separately.

cases.prompt: Run an OSS readiness audit on this repo.
expected_behavior: Skill 'oss-ready-flow' does NOT trigger (audit-only is the 'oss-ready' skill's territory).

cases.prompt: Rewrite my README to be cleaner.
expected_behavior: A doc-focused or README-focused skill (docs-generator or similar) triggers, or the agent edits directly without a skill.
